looks_bad_but_fine.why: 302 lines and highest hotspot score in the repo, but it is one function (PathFor) plus a single static map literal of 290 name-to-path entries. One responsibility, no field clustering, no fan-out to other units — a data table, not a god-class.
Fluent builder pattern (WithName/WithPort/WithTLS/Build chained on *Builder) is wide by design per the family's own trap list, not a god-class.

not_assessed: Fan-in/coupling could not be verified beyond the fan_in_approx values supplied in the leads; no additional call-graph tooling was run.
SQL injection in internal/store/store.go:38 and hardcoded credential/TLS bypass in internal/httpc/httpc.go:9,13 are real issues but belong to a security family, not god-classes, so not reported here.
